author: Ksmudger_
body:
• Your minecraft username(most recent name if changed) RealAtom is my current ign name.
  • The reason you were temp-banned/banned I was being rude to another player a few days ago, when he/her accused me of being bad because I killed him/her, I started messaging inappropriate words, which followed with a 1 month temp-ban. I understand what I did was WRONG. But I think a month is a bit much for an argument, if it was 1 day or so I would of accepted my punishment and understood for my misbehaviour was wrong. I hope you take my ban appeal in some sort of consideration, please unban me. Or at least decrease my ban time because I really enjoy this server!
  • Why you should be unbanned from the server. I love your server, one of my favourite nebula and combat servers, being banned from it for a month is a long time for me not playing because I like having a game of nebula now and then. I'm sorry for my rudeness towards that player (forgot his name sorry) and the Moderator who was there at the time (Jiveh)
